claim: S0 pedestrian-height low-speed condition is quasi-omnidirectional across the eight simulated directions.
Vertical mean-VR recovery from z~2 m to z~40 m is positive in every simulated direction.
S1/S2 global z~2 m mean-VR deltas remain negative in all eight simulated directions.
S2 has localized directionally sensitive common-open-cell response, strongest at 315 deg, but this does not produce global pedestrian-layer recovery.
